subject: Pilot conversion economics & exit guardrails for private VPC deployment
messages:
From: Jared Cohen <jared.cohen@helixhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Anna Liu <anna.liu@helixhealth.com>, procurement@helixhealth.com
Date: 2026-03-22T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Private deployment — final ask on pilot pricing and migration guardrails

Vanessa — thanks for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to get a single-page view we can take to legal and finance: total cost for a 3-month pilot (expected ~1.5M tokens/day), and the commercial terms if we convert to production after pilot. Two items are blocking approval here: a one-time migration credit (to cover our SRE migration work) and a cap on any early-exit charges should we choose to stop after the pilot.

High level ask: can Redwood provide (a) a pilot invoice model we can accept internally (discounted platform fee + metered usage), (b) a conversion credit that applies if we sign a committed tier within 60 days of pilot end, and (c) a clear exit cap (maximum liability for unused committed fees/pilot termination).

Budget is constrained for Q2; we need an answer today to move the procurement queue.

—Jared
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jared Cohen <jared.cohen@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T10:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment — final ask on pilot pricing and migration guardrails

Jared — appreciate the clarity and the urgency. Quick answers up front, then details below: (1) We can offer a 50% discount on the platform fee for the 3-month pilot (metered compute and embeddings billed normally). (2) If you convert to a 12-month committed tier within 60 days of pilot end, we will apply a conversion credit equal to 100% of the discounted platform fees paid during the pilot (applied across first three invoice cycles). (3) Exit cap: we can cap early-exit liability to the equivalent of 1.5x the remaining monthly platform fee for any unused committed months, with a maximum not to exceed the aggregate platform fees already paid during the pilot.

Details / assumptions: pilot expected utilization of N40 equivalents ~2x peak concurrency — helps us size reserved capacity. The credit requires a signed order form that references the deal ID below; legal can bake in the migration credit language.

I've looped in Marissa for commercial confirmation and Priyom for implementation SOW & migration support scoping. I'm attaching a short SOW + price breakdown for your procurement team.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachments (see attached): HelixHealth_SOW_v1.pdf, helix_pricing_breakdown.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment — final ask on pilot pricing and migration guardrails

Vanessa — quick commercial note: the conversion-credit approach you proposed is fine, but procurement will push back on a 1.5x early-exit multiplier. Recommend we offer a hard cap equal to the lesser of (a) 3 months of committed platform fees or (b) the total platform fees paid during the pilot. That gives Helix comfort without exposing Redwood to outsized clawbacks.

Also recommend we define support tiers for the pilot explicitly:
- Standard Pilot Support (included): 24/5 ticketing, 8 business-hour response, weekly syncs
- Pilot SRE Retainer (optional): 2x on-call rotation for 3 months, 4 hours/mo of hands-on tuning, at $12k/month

If they want full 24/7 SRE during pilot we should price that separately (emergency on-call supplement). Priyom: can you confirm the estimated migration effort (hours) for the SOW so we can size the credit?

-Marissa
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T13:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment — final ask on pilot pricing and migration guardrails

Quick from engineering: migration for the initial pilot (VPC peering, initial model onboarding, basic infra automation) is ~120–160 engineering hours across our delivery team (two engineers + one solutions lead), assuming Helix provides network contacts and infra access within the first two weeks. Conservative estimate: 160 hours. If we price that at blended $180/hr for SOW labor, that's ~$28,800. My suggestion: convert that into a one-time migration credit applied to their first invoice if they convert; if they don't convert, the credit is void. That keeps procurement happy and keeps our billing simple.

I'll update the SOW attachment with the hour breakdown and the tasks.
—Priyom
From: Jared Cohen <jared.cohen@helixhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Anna Liu <anna.liu@helixhealth.com>, procurement@helixhealth.com
Date: 2026-03-22T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment — final ask on pilot pricing and migration guardrails

Thanks — this level of detail is great and gets us to a yes from procurement. Two follow-ups before I route to legal: (1) confirm the exit cap language to Marissa's suggestion (lesser of 3 months committed fees or pilot fees paid), and (2) include a clause that any migration credit is applied only against Redwood usage/platform invoices (not against third-party tooling).

If you can send a DocuSign order with the SOW reference and a redline-able legal addendum, we can get signatures by end of week.

I'll expect the updated SOW and the DocuSign link.

—Jared
